target_customer: Research scientists, doctors and enterprise R&D teams that search scientific literature
problem: Keyword search on PubMed and Google Scholar misses relevant papers for complex, specific questions.
business_model: Freemium SaaS subscription (Pro, Team per seat, Enterprise custom)

founders.name: Joshua Ramette
founders.background_notes: Research in gravitational wave astrophysics (LIGO), particle physics (CERN), atomic physics; employers not stated on YC page.

founders.name: Tom Hartke
founders.background_notes: Thesis recognized by the American Physical Society as a top atomic physics thesis of 2022.

technical_complexity.rationale: Adaptive LLM-driven exploration of large literature databases with claimed high recall required retrieval research beyond standard RAG in 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Quality edge on recall is claimed by the company and depends on model access; frontier labs and academic search tools can replicate agentic search.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not sourced; frontier labs later shipped deep research agents (not verified here).

market_need_then: The company cites about 50 million researchers searching PubMed and Google Scholar monthly and says it had paying users across medicine, ML and biotech at the batch.

branding.domain_note: Uses undermind.ai; no source on acquisition.

identity.voice_and_tone: Scientist-to-scientist: 'Your AI co-researcher for the literature'

branding.community_and_virality: Used and cited in university library guides (for example HKUST), per search results.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand-focused press found; library guides and a Product Hunt launch show modest awareness.

outcome_analysis: Undermind is active with scientist founders and visible adoption, including a claimed GSK deployment of over 1,000 scientists and DOE national lab users. Funding appears small and unverified, so its trajectory is hard to judge. The main risk is that general AI deep research tools absorb the use case, which is not yet evidenced.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights reports about 500K total with a September 2024 seed VC round and investor lists that differ across aggregators (Y Combinator and Pioneer Fund appear in all). Only aggregators, so no round recorded. No dated competitor sources near the batch found, so the list is empty. No outcome news found.
